speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies infestation. The chronic, pruritic rash on the bilateral upper extremities that worsens at night is highly characteristic of scabies, especially given the duration of 5 months despite the absence of new exposures.
